comment: Standalone Cybersalt products the manager knows about even when cybersalt.com has no api.packages endpoint. Live versions, download URLs and requirements always come from the update feed (api.updatexml); this file only adds the display details the feed doesn't carry. MCP add-ons come from api.catalog, not from here.

items.title: Cybersalt Extension Manager
items.description: Install, update and look after every Cybersalt extension from one screen.

items.title: Cybersalt MCP for Joomla
items.description: Turns your site into its own MCP server, so ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and other AI apps can work with it through an API token or OAuth sign-in.

items.title: Cybersalt Page Protector
items.description: Puts a proof-of-work check in front of the pages and modules you choose, so scrapers pay before they get your content.

items.title: Cybersalt Override Checker
items.description: Template-aware integrity monitor that adds a real baseline and AI-assisted triage to Joomla's own template override check.

items.title: Cybersalt SiteGround Cache
items.description: Makes SiteGround's server cache work on Joomla: strips the headers that block it, keeps form pages uncached and purges pages when content changes.

items.title: Cybersalt Edge Cache Marker
items.description: Sets a marker cookie when an editor logs in, so Cloudflare and other edge caches skip cached pages for editors and keep serving them to everyone else.

items.title: Cybersalt Articles Module Maxxed
items.description: Adds a "skip the first N articles" offset setting to Joomla's core articles modules.

items.title: Cybersalt 0-9 and A-Z Menu
items.description: An A-Z / 0-9 browse bar that filters category listings by the first character of the article title.

items.title: Cybersalt Remove Sample Data
items.description: Finds and removes what Joomla's Blog and Multilingual sample-data plugins installed, with a preview, per-item opt-out and an activity log.

items.title: Cybersalt Release Manager
items.description: Extension store and update server for Joomla: host your packages, serve update XML, gate paid downloads with download IDs and track installations.
